In the closed mouth position, the disc is in an anterior position relative to the condylar head and the disc reduces upon opening of the mouth. A history of prior locking in the closed position coupled with interference in mastication precludes this diagnosis.

This temporal relationship to invasive dental treatment fits the ICOP excerpt for painful post-traumatic trigeminal neuropathy, which requires pain for more than 3 months, a history of mechanical injury to a peripheral trigeminal nerve, onset within 6 months after the injury, and associated somatosensory symptoms and/or signs in a plausible trigeminal distribution.      - Exact timing of pain onset relative to extraction and implant placement
     - Whether onset occurred immediately or within 6 months of the procedure
